fixture: Each arm opens a fresh production authored-changes page. The zero arm seeds accepted Sed. blocks without pre-existing proposals. The matched arm seeds accepted Sd. blocks and proposes insertion of e in every block. The retained arm seeds accepted Seed. blocks and proposes deletion of the first e in every block. Both review arms therefore have N pending records, the same first-50 review cards and the same proposed Sed. output. The primary proposed view receives input; the second view is accepted and the remaining six views are read-only markup observers. The route's independent editor stays mounted.
action: Collapse to the start of the first proposed text, type 10 warmup characters, then measure 50 trusted printable keys through measurePliteTrustedTyping. Exact native input, model, DOM, caret and double-animation-frame readiness participate. Full setup, value reads, garbage collection and final assertions are outside the timed operation.
order: Alternate zero/matched/retained and retained/matched/zero arm order by pass. Every arm uses a fresh browser context. Run views-1, views-2, views-8 and fully-mounted-large in that order; a failed cohort stops the target.
environment: Production static export with verified build manifest/source digest, one Chromium worker, default desktop viewport and unthrottled local host. Preserve every pass, trusted-key row, long task, source fingerprint, browser identity and post-GC metric.
correctness: Every arm mounts exactly the selected number of shared Editable roots and exactly blocks times views top-level block DOM nodes, with zero viewport placeholders. In the retained arm, each markup view mounts exactly one retained e for every pending deletion; the other arms and accepted views mount none. Every original pending ID remains pending, accepted content and the independent editor remain exact, proposed Sed. text reaches every projected view and runtime errors are empty. Canonical IDs are read through the accepted view before a one-view cohort unmounts it and after the measured heap sample remounts it.
heap: After input and equivalent two-frame quiescence, take three readings. Before each reading, run HeapProfiler.collectGarbage twice and then read Performance.getMetrics. Use the median JSHeapUsedSize and compare retained deletion with the fresh-context matched pending-insertion arm for the same block, pending-record, review-card and view cohort. Record every sample plus median DOM Nodes, Documents and JSEventListeners when Chromium exposes them. This is retained live-page heap, not construction peak or process RSS.

Version-1 evidence remains in execution/browser-authored-mounted-target-2-*.json.

Version-2 evidence remains in execution/browser-authored-mounted-target-3-*.json.

executionCorrection: Version 5 enforces serial, zero-retry Playwright execution so the three passes use the contract's declared one-worker environment. limits: The zero arm reports no-pre-existing-review behavior with the authored capability installed; it does not prove disabled-capability overhead. The matched insertion arm is a current native semantic control, not a legacy implementation or speedup baseline. The double-requestAnimationFrame timestamp is a presentation opportunity, not a compositor timestamp. Fixture construction and view-count changes are excluded, so this packet does not claim cold page hydration. The large cohort proves complete mounted DOM at 1000 blocks and two views; it is separate from the virtualized large typing packet. Decisions, collaboration transport, archive output and physical IME remain separate gates.
noise: Do not retry an unchanged failed row. Preserve it and isolate the measured owner before another run. Budgets cannot change after measurement.
